semiconductor_relevance: High — the company provides a range of equipment and solutions specifically for the semiconductor packaging back-end industry.
summary: Shanghai Matfron Technology Co., Ltd specializes in providing comprehensive solutions for the semiconductor packaging back-end industry, including various process and inspection equipment, as well as consumables. They are a strategic partner of Kulicke & Soffa, offering a one-stop service for their product line, and have developed proprietary equipment for packaging and testing.
